source.title: 120. Milosrđe Božje - Kako raste kraljevstvo Božje?

summary.title_hr: 120. Milosrđe Božje - Kako raste kraljevstvo Božje?
summary.abstract_hr: Epizoda medija Ora et labora počinje molitvama za zaštitu, posvetom Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i Presvetom Srcu Isusovu, krunicom Božjeg milosrđa, litanijama Božjem milosrđu i žalosnim otajstvima Gospine krunice. U tumačenju svete riječi Vladimir Grebenar polazi od Pavlova teksta o braku kao slici otajstva Krista i Crkve te od psalma 'Blago svakome koji se boji Gospodina'. Oštro kritizira prihvaćanje istospolnih zajednica i dio klera, laika i političara koji, prema njegovim riječima, šute o grijehu. Zatim tumači evanđelje (Lk 13,18-21) o gorušičinu zrnu i kvascu: Bog djeluje kroz neznatno i skriveno, a za sve vrijedno potrebno je vrijeme i strpljivost. Emisija završava najavom promocija knjige 'Isus lider, treći dio', pozivom na učlanjenje u domoljubnu inicijativu Ora et labora, svjedočanstvima slušatelja i pozivom muškarcima na javnu molitvu krunice.
key_topics: brak kao otajstvo krista i crkve
kritika tolerancije prema grijehu i dijela klera
prispodobe o gorušičinu zrnu i kvascu
key_points: Govornik ističe da otajstvo Krista i Crkve mora biti temelj osobnog i obiteljskog života, života naroda i cijelog svijeta. Bračno sjedinjenje muža i žene u jedno tijelo opisuje kao sliku jedinstva Presvetog Trojstva.

Tvrdi da predbračni odnosi i mijenjanje partnera ne donose mir ni blagoslov, nego nezadovoljstvo, te da kontinuirani seksualni razvrat vodi do homoseksualnosti. Istodobno poručuje da osobe s takvim sklonostima ne treba osuđivati, nego im navijestiti Krista i moliti za njih.

Kritizira dio klera, laika i političara koji u ime tolerancije ne osuđuju grijeh i koji su legalizirali istospolne zajednice. Kao primjer navodi osobno iskustvo od prije otprilike 15 godina s dodatnog obrazovanja na pedagoškom fakultetu, gdje je naišao na agresivan prezir kolega kad je izrazio neslaganje.
Strah Gospodnji objašnjava kao bojazan da neće biti dobra strana u savezu s Bogom, a ne kao strah od kazne, jer, kako kaže, Bog ne želi kažnjavati i ne kažnjava.

Smatra da šutnja pred javnim zlom odgovara definiciji bezakonika. Tko nekoga iz druge religije naziva prijateljem, dužan mu je navijestiti Krista, pozivajući se na Isusove posljednje riječi: tko povjeruje i pokrsti se, spasit će se.

Prispodobe o gorušičinu zrnu i kvascu tumači kao pouku da Bog djeluje kroz nešto neznatno i skriveno te da sve vrijedno za kraljevstvo Božje traži vrijeme. Prispodobe, prema njegovim riječima, otvaraju oči onima otvorena srca, dok ih farizejski, 'kontrolabilni' duh ne razumije.

Najavljuje promocije knjige 'Isus lider, treći dio' u više gradova i ističe da je članstvo u inicijativi Ora et labora moguće bez članarine i donacije. Prenosi svjedočanstva o ozdravljenjima i poziva muškarce na javnu molitvu krunice, među ostalim u Zagrebu 7. studenog.
mentioned_organizations: Ora et labora (medij i domoljubna inicijativa)
key_topics_en: prayer and the chaplet of divine mercy
marriage as a mystery of christ and the church
criticism of tolerance toward sin and part of the clergy
parables of the mustard seed and the leaven
promotion of the book jesus the leader
key_points_en: The speaker emphasizes that the mystery of Christ and the Church must be the foundation of personal and family life, the life of the nation, and the entire world. He describes the marital union of husband and wife into one flesh as an image of the unity of the Most Holy Trinity.

He claims that premarital relations and changing partners do not bring peace or blessing, but dissatisfaction, and that continuous sexual debauchery leads to homosexuality. At the same time, he conveys that persons with such inclinations should not be condemned, but rather Christ should be proclaimed to them and prayers offered for them.

He criticizes part of the clergy, laity, and politicians who, in the name of tolerance, do not condemn sin and who have legalized same-sex unions. As an example, he cites a personal experience from approximately 15 years ago during additional education at a pedagogical faculty, where he encountered aggressive contempt from colleagues when he expressed disagreement.

He explains the fear of the Lord as an apprehension that one will not be a good party in the covenant with God, rather than as a fear of punishment, because, as he says, God does not want to punish and does not punish.

He considers that silence in the face of public evil corresponds to the definition of the lawless. Whoever calls someone from another religion a friend is obliged to proclaim Christ to him, citing Jesus' last words: whoever believes and is baptized will be saved.

He interprets the parables of the mustard seed and the leaven as a lesson that God works through something insignificant and hidden, and that everything worthwhile for the kingdom of God takes time. Parables, according to his words, open the eyes of those with an open heart, while a Pharisaic, 'controllable' spirit does not understand them.

He announces book promotions for 'Jesus the Leader, Part Three' in several cities and points out that membership in the Ora et labora initiative is possible without membership fees and donations. He conveys testimonies of healings and invites men to the public prayer of the Rosary, among others in Zagreb on November 7.

summary.title_en: 120. Divine Mercy - How Does the Kingdom of God Grow?
summary.abstract_en: The episode of the Ora et labora media begins with prayers for protection, consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and the Sacred Heart of Jesus, the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, the Litany of Divine Mercy, and the Sorrowful Mysteries of the Our Lady's Rosary. In his interpretation of the holy word, Vladimir Grebenar starts from Paul's text on marriage as an image of the mystery of Christ and the Church, and from the psalm 'Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord'. He sharply criticizes the acceptance of same-sex unions and a part of the clergy, laity, and politicians who, according to his words, remain silent about sin. Then he interprets the Gospel (Lk 13:18-21) about the mustard seed and the leaven: God works through the insignificant and the hidden, and everything worthwhile requires time and patience. The broadcast ends with the announcement of book promotions for 'Jesus the Leader, Part Three', an invitation to join the patriotic initiative Ora et labora, testimonies of listeners, and an invitation to men for the public recitation of the Rosary.
